annotations.title: ENS Resolve: ENS Name to Address and Address to Primary Name

description: Resolve an ENS name (e.g. vitalik.eth) to its Ethereum address, or look up the reverse-record name of an address, via the ENS registry on Ethereum mainnet. Onchain resolvers only; off-chain (CCIP-read) names report resolved=false. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

address.description: Address for a reverse lookup (used if name is not set).

name: ens_resolve
